sloka: वयं युद्धादिहैष्यामो रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः।विदार्यं स्वतनुं बाणै रामनामाङ्कितैः शितैः ।। ६.६४.२५ ।।
transliteration: vayaṁ yuddhādihaiṣyāmo rudhireṇa samukṣitāḥ।vidāryaṁ svatanuṁ bāṇai rāmanāmāṅkitaiḥ śitaiḥ ।। 6.64.25 ।।

translations.english: "Bathed in blood, wounded by the arrows marked with Rama's name, bodies torn cruelly we will come here from war."
